main_text.p: AMYRALDVS eandem semper doctrinam secutus est, eamque perspicuè demonstrauit cap. 12. Defensionis Calvini & Concione V. de Natura Euan-gelij.

Arminiani credunt tametsi Euangelium inter nationes infideles non praedicetur, earum tamen ideo conditionem haud multo deteriorem esse quam reliquarum, quia Deus illis salutem offert aut aequè aut saltem fere aequè ac iis quibus Euangelium praedicatur, adeò vt contingere queat vt aliqui ea ratione sa-lutem consequantur.

Orthodoxi contra statuunt praeter obscuritatem reuelationis quae infinitis prope partibus imperfectior est ea quae sit per verbum, Verbi singularem quandam praestantiam in ea sitam esse, quod solum est ministerium Spiritus, quo id-circo solo homines ad salutem addu-cuntur.

AMYRALDVS eandem cum Ortho-doxis doctrinam & animo penitus im-bibit, & aduersus Arminianos defendit Concione 3. de Natura Euangelij, & cap. 13. Defensionis Calvini. Superest igitur externa vocatio quae fit per ver[illegible, ~3 letters]

page.notes: The page number at the head reads as "13" but the final digit is a long-form 3 and is marked [?]. The last line is cut off by the bottom edge of the scan and the word after "per ver" cannot be read. The line "Ortho-doxis" and "Euan-gelij" are printed hyphenated line-end breaks and are kept as printed. Bottom edge shows damage and show-through, not transcribed.
